candidates.title: How MoEngage turned over 400 APIs into agent tools with AgentCore Gateway
candidates.summary: MoEngage turned roughly 400 private REST APIs across 7 AWS Regions into permission-scoped agent tools with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway. No per-service MCP servers, no public endpoints, and no 400-tool context bloat. See how OpenAPI specs, Cedar policies, and managed Amazon VPC Lattice egress made it work.

candidates.title: Accelerate agentic AI with NVIDIA Nemotron models on Amazon EKS and SageMaker HyperPod EKS
candidates.summary: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is a 120B-parameter mixture-of-experts model that pairs reasoning and tool use with multimodal understanding. This post explores its architecture and use cases, then shows how to deploy it on Amazon EKS, EKS Auto Mode, and Amazon SageMaker HyperPod EKS with NVIDIA Dynamo and vLLM.

candidates.title: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
candidates.summary: OpenAI’s updated Model Spec outlines five core values to guide more capable AI toward sound judgment, human agency, and faithfulness to human intent.

candidates.title: Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences
candidates.summary: OpenAI will honor a shared robots.txt signal to help website operators communicate their AI training preferences to participating providers.

candidates.title: DoorDash said it’s only received ‘several hundred’ orders from AI agents
candidates.summary: DoorDash said that it is open to working with third-party agent makers.

candidates.title: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings acquires ADT
candidates.summary: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings is buying ADT in a $15.3 billion deal, with plans to bring AI to the home security business.
